name: EFC claim-status register (Gamma forms and BE exponents)
curation_note: Hand-curated additive register; provenance (when) is carried by the commit, not this file.
purpose: Canonical claim-maturity status for the published Gamma(rho) forms and BE exponents. Additive; does not replace status-levels.json or the findings/proposals status vocabularies.

crosswalk.note: Three vocabularies coexist by design: (1) status-levels.json = test/observation axis; (2) findings status (open/conditional/reviewed_no_conflict_found) = finding lifecycle; (3) this register = claim maturity. A claim can be declared_derived here and still open as a finding. 'representation_status' records WHERE a form appears (metadata, code header, derivation); it is not part of the claim-maturity vocabulary.

entries.note: Phenomenological baseline; the code names it the phenomenological ansatz, not the derived result.

entries.internal_tension: the package's requirement row R2 targets saturation while the declared result is non-saturating
entries.note: Derived form per key_result and code gamma_total; non-saturating at high density. Whether this conflicts with the supersession-to-B+ reading is gated on author word.
Declared in 31942800 as Scenario B+; the 31942821 code header names it an upgrade.
Appears in 31942821 metadata and 31941543; not the derived form.

Wording resolved to an explicit conditional falsification threshold by author word (2026-09-20): kill_criteria[0] now reads 'If ... then the E proportional to sqrt(g) theorem is falsified', matching the array's own semantics (KC2-KC5 are counterfactual) and PDF Section 2.4/Table 1 (C3 linear eliminated, C5 sqrt survives).
